title: Carelink login not working with xdrip
symptom: CareLink server only works with Medtronic applications; xDrip can no longer connect to the server (carelink.minimed.eu). Users report a 400 error when downloading data from CareLink, even after changing username/password and trying old and new xDrip versions.
cause: CareLink changed its API to require patient information in the payload for care partner accounts. Previously the payload contained only username and role, but after the update it also requires a patientId. This change affects standalone CGM users and multi-patient follow scenarios.
fix: The latest release (2023.05.26) addresses the issue. For a temporary workaround, use the patient account instead of the care partner account. A more permanent fix was implemented in the latest release.
